source.text: ወይዴመሩ፡ ኵሉ፡ ማያት፡ [ዘ]ምስለ፡ ማያት፡ ዘመልዕልተ፡ ሰማያት፡ ተባዕታይ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወማይ፡ ዘመትሕተ፡ ምድር፡ አንስታይት፡ ይእቲ።
source.note: The selected text locally brackets ዘ immediately before ምስለ, with; the source retains this editorial sign. The English follows the with-construction without inserting another relative before it. This verse also lies within a larger editorial bracket that opens at 54:7 and closes after 55:2; its words are retained as part of the selected critical edition, not a separately certified manuscript reading. Male and female are explicit descriptions of the upper and lower waters. The source uses singular masculine ውእቱ and feminine ይእቲ as copulas; which are male recasts the following masculine predicate to agree with plural waters in English. No human or angelic figures, physical reproduction, or another textual witness are supplied.

translation.text: And all the waters will mingle with the waters above the heavens, which are male; and the water beneath the earth is female.[a]
